weasel_words.quote: 'Make up to $21 an hour' — ceiling framing; actual pay varies by job and market.

repeatable.cadence: Claim a moving job in the app, finish it, collect your tips — and repeat as many jobs as your city offers each week.

maximize: Book jobs in dense urban zones to cut unpaid drive time between gigs; stack weekend jobs when demand and tips peak; ask about bonus windows in the app and prioritize those slots; keep ratings high since top-rated movers get first pick of the best jobs.
who_pays: Bellhop pays you weekly — your hourly pay plus customer tips and bonuses all come through Bellhop's weekly payout, not directly from the customer on the day.
who_qualifies: You must be 18 or older, able to lift 50+ lbs repeatedly all day, pass Bellhop's application and background screening, and live in a city where Bellhop operates.
work_available: Moving jobs go through Bellhop's app and volume is market-dependent — some cities have steady bookings while others have sparse jobs, so don't count on full-time hours until you see your local demand.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid for completed moving jobs you claim in the app, and customer ratings decide who gets first pick of the best jobs — top-rated movers win the most work. Bellhop's specific non-payment triggers and removal policy are not publicly stated.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Signing up is officially free and the background check is part of the application at no stated cost. Unpaid time: the application and screening process, waiting between jobs, and driving between job sites — none of which earns the hourly rate.
when_cash_arrives: Bellhop pays you weekly — you work all week before seeing a dollar, so this is not same-day or next-day money.
